title: Xihlambanyo xa Lava nga si velekiwaka
intro: Moya-xiviri lowu tshembekaka wu endle xitshembiso xo kwetsima loko n’wana a nga si fika. Mhaka ya xifaniso lexi yi humelela endzeni ka marhangu ya ndhawu yo kwetsima, laha ku tinyiketela ku hlanganaka ni ku amukeriwa hi Xikwembu. Xana nandza loyi wa Allah i mani?
clues: A ndzi ri wa ndyangu lowu xiximiwaka eka Quran.
Ndzi endle xihlambanyo lexi tiyeke xo nyiketela n’wana wa mina loyi a nga si velekiwaka entirhweni wa Allah.
Loko ndzi veleka, ndzi hlamarile ku kuma leswaku a ku ri n’wana wa nhwanyana, hambileswi a ndzi langutele n’wana wa jaha.
Ndzi thye n’wana wa mina vito ra Maryam, ku nga vito leri kombisaka ku tinyiketela ni ku tirhela.
Ndzi lave nsirhelelo wa Allah eka n’wana wa mina ni vatukulu va yena eka Sathana la rhukaniweke.
N’wana wa mina u amukeriwile hi Hosi kutani a vekiwa ehansi ka nhlayiso wa Muprofeta Zakariya evukwetsimelweni.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Nsati wa Imran (Manana wa Maryam) .
Asiya, nsati wa Faro
Mariyamu, mana wa Esa
Mana wa Muprofeta Musa
Hosi ya xisati ya le Xeba

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku hlambanya ku nyiketela n’wana wa yena etempeleni
Ku lahleriwa endzilweni
Ku tsemakanya lwandle emisaveni leyi omeke
Ku aka ngalava leyikulu
Ku mitiwa hi nhlampfi leyikulu
trial.answer: Ku hlambanya ku nyiketela n’wana wa yena etempeleni

location.label: Xiphemu xa Nkoka
options: Ndhawu yo kwetsima (mihrab) laha n’wana wa yena a vekiweke kona
Areka ya ntwanano
Rhole ra nsuku
Nhonga leyi hundzukeke nyoka
Nsinya wa date lowu a a wisa ehansi ka wona
location.answer: Ndhawu yo kwetsima (mihrab) laha n’wana wa yena a vekiweke kona

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: N’wana wa yena u amukeriwile kutani a vekiwa ehansi ka nhlayiso wa Muprofeta Zakariya
U ponisiwile eka nxupulo wa mufumi wa tihanyi
U nyikiwe n’wana wa jaha la vuriwaka Yahya
Vanhu va ka vona va lovisiwe hi xidzedze
U ve hosi ya xisati ehenhla ka mfumo lowukulu
outcome.answer: N’wana wa yena u amukeriwile kutani a vekiwa ehansi ka nhlayiso wa Muprofeta Zakariya

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
